reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is local retrieval of prior conversation history, including fuzzy and semantic recall after compaction.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于本地索引的对话历史检索，支持关键词、模糊和语义召回。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with locally indexed conversation-history retrieval using literal, fuzzy, and semantic search.

capabilities: Indexes conversation history in a local SQLite database
Retrieves past conversation content using literal, fuzzy, and local semantic search
Reads session data and injects lightweight recall anchors after compaction
Runs background local embedding and indexing work
